jobs.description:
Are you passionate about transport and logistics? Bleckmann is looking for you! 

We are looking for logistics employees for the Bleckmann warehouses in Rieme and Desteldonk (near Ghent). You will be working in the morning shift (05u48 - 13u48) or late shift (14u00 - 22u00).

This is a temporary assignment during a busy and dynamic peak period. It's a great opportunity to gain experience in logistics. As Bleckmann operates multiple peak periods throughout the year (such as Black Friday in November), you will have the opportunity to return for future assignments.

Are you interested in this opportunity? Be sure to read this vacancy!

Tasks: 

• Preparing incoming orders

• You prepare the orders in order of arrival using a scanning system

• You prepare the correct documents when packing orders

We organize bus transport from Ghent to ensure easy access to Bleckmann:  

• Back and forth ride from the station of Gent-Sint-Pieters for the Rieme warehouse

• Back and forth ride from the station of Gent-Dampoort for the Desteldonk warehouse

• Departure at 5u10 or 13u10

 

• Positive attitude

• Good numerical skills

• Flexibility

• Punctuality

• Fluent in either Dutch, English or French

As a robotic engineer, you will be part of our driven engineering team, where you will work together to develop high-quality software solutions. Your tasks will include:

• Develop, maintain, and improve robotic software using ROS2

• Integrate and optimize navigation stacks, SLAM, and sensor fusion

• Build perception systems using Computer Vision (e.g., object detection, visual localization)

• Design and deploy Machine Learning models for robotic perception and autonomous decision-making

• Work hands-on with real robots: system integration, deployment, tuning, and performance optimization

• Contribute to robot control, localization, and path planning

• Participate in on-site testing and customer deployments across Belgium and the Netherlands

• You are hands-on and have at least 3 to 5 years of experience and strong affinity with autonomous navigation, robotics, machine control or industrial automation

• You have a thorough knowledge of ROS2, C, C++, and Python

• Solid knowledge in majority of the following fields:Sensor fusion for state estimation and localization

• Control systems for robotics

• Path planning & Navigation (SLAM)

• Computer Vision and Machine Learning applied to robotics

• You are comfortable working with hardware and in real-world field environments and experience bringing systems from prototype to reliable field deployment

• You are able to work independently and take responsibility for your work

• You have a valid EU driving license (for site testing and deployments)

• You can communicate fluently in English

jobs.occupation: Multilingual Customer Advisor – DE/EN/(NL or FR) in Liège
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about delivering outstanding customer service and fluent in multiple languages? As a Customer Advisor in our Liège-based team, you’ll be the first point of contact for customers, ensuring their needs are met with professionalism and efficiency. You’ll interact with international clients through various channels – calls, emails, and chat – providing accurate, friendly, and timely support.

You will support Satellic customers through different communication channels and provide professional, efficient assistance regarding their requests and issues: handling calls, emails, and chats related to the road toll for freight vehicles in Belgium and, in the future, other projects such as Monizze, Arrive, Fain and verification of on-board documents via the CRM system.

Ready to take the next step in your career? If you have strong language skills, a commitment to delivering excellent service, and thrive in a fast-paced, multicultural environment, we want to hear from you. Apply today and become a valued member of our international customer service team in Liège!

• Excellent command of English, both spoken and written

• Successful completion of an English language assessment

• Strong communication and customer service skills

• Good computer literacy and ability to learn new systems

• Ability to work in a fast-paced, multicultural environment

• Fluency in one or more of the following language combinations: Dutch + English, German + English, German + English + French, or German + English + Dutch

• Trilingual candidates are highly valued

• Additional language skills may qualify for a language bonus

• Upper secondary education completed

• 2 to 5 years of relevant experience in customer service or a related field

• Availability for rotating shifts between 07:00 and 22:00 (potential for homeworking)

• Full-time availability

Our client, an international organisation active in technical services and customer support, is undergoing a major digital transformation across its European operations. To support this journey, they are looking for an experienced Business Analyst & Transformation Project Lead .

In this key position within the organization , you will drive business improvement initiatives, manage strategic projects, and act as the link between operational teams and IT.

Key Responsibilities

Project & Programme Management

• Manage a portfolio of business transformation and IT-related projects.
• Define priorities, timelines, budgets, and project deliverables.
• Coordinate stakeholders and ensure projects are delivered on time and within scope.
• Identify and mitigate risks throughout the project lifecycle.
Business Process Improvement

• Analyse existing business processes and identify opportunities for optimisation.
• Drive initiatives focused on standardisation, automation, and digitalisation.
• Support the development of scalable and efficient operational practices.
Requirements Analysis

• Gather, analyse, and document business requirements.
• Translate operational and commercial needs into clear functional specifications.
• Ensure requirements are understood by technical teams and external partners.
• Solution Development
Collaborate closely with IT and business systems teams.

• Evaluate and implement solutions that support both current and future business needs.
• Ensure technology investments deliver measurable business value.
Commercial & Supplier Management

• Support and lead commercial initiatives related to projects and business improvements.
• Manage relationships with external suppliers and service providers.
• Participate in contract discussions and monitor project budgets and performance.
 

Stakeholder Management

• Act as the primary contact between business operations and IT teams
• Build strong relationships across departments and facilitate effective communication.
• Ensure business priorities are clearly understood and aligned.

• Has proven experience managing business transformation projects and programmes.
• Demonstrates strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Is comfortable working with data and translating insights into actionable recommendations.
• Possesses strong commercial awareness and can assess the business impact of decisions.
• Has experience gathering and documenting business requirements.
• Can communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• Builds strong working relationships and influences stakeholders at different levels.
• Thrives in a dynamic environment and can manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
• Has experience working with IT, ERP, CRM, or other business systems teams.
• Is fluent in English; knowledge of Dutch and/or French  is considered an asset.

As a future butcher / deboner of pork meat, you will work on different lines with tasks such as cutting shoulders, bellies, and ribs. 

Experience is an asset, but motivated newcomers are welcome. 

Thanks to the Butchers Academy, you will receive comprehensive training, followed by a permanent contract and annual evaluations offering opportunities for advancement.

We are looking for ambitious and eager-to-learn individuals who can start early (start at 4.55 AM) and are flexible in their schedules depending on the season. 

You should be comfortable working in a cold environment and have an affinity for the food industry (pork meat), along with the associated quality and hygiene standards. 

You must be physically capable of standing and working all day and place importance on workplace safety. 

Language is not a barrier; everyone has equal opportunities, whether you speak English, French, or Dutch.

Our client, a great player in the world of logistics, is looking for a handy production employee. They are looking in the department that makes the black boxes is looking for a new colleague. 

The job

• operating the pick and place machine
• micro welding of different electronic components
• assembling and wiring of electronic components 
• quality check of the production proces 

• very good knowledge of French and English
• experience in micro welding

You will support the Customer Service team with tasks such as order entry, stock assignment, requests of certificates, etc.

 As you will progress in your training, the responsibilities can be expanded to direct customer support and coordination of the full order to cash process for a selected amount of customers.

• Act as a key point of contact for assigned customers and provide professional and timely support.
• Manage the end-to-end order process, including order entry, verification, delivery coordination and invoicing.
• Maintain accurate customer and order information in the systems.
• Provide customers and Sales colleagues with clear updates on order and delivery status.
• Prepare relevant documentation, including order confirmations, delivery documents and certificates.
• Respond to customer inquiries and help resolve order, delivery, pricing or product-related questions.
• Register and follow up on customer complaints, returns and other order-related issues.
• Work closely with Sales and internal stakeholders to ensure an efficient customer experience.
• Collaborate with colleagues across Customer Service, Supply Chain, Sales, Quality and other departments.
 

• You have experience in Customer Service, Sales Support, Order Management, Administration or a similar environment. 
• You are customer-focused, organized and comfortable managing different priorities and administrative tasks.
• You communicate clearly and enjoy working with customers and colleagues from different countries and cultures.
• You are confident working with Microsoft Excel, Outlook and Teams.
• Experience with SAP or another ERP system is considered a strong advantage.
• You are fluent in English, both spoken and written.
• Knowledge of Russian is an additional asset, but is not required.
• You work accurately, take ownership and enjoy contributing to a collaborative team environment.

jobs.occupation: Warehouse worker - night shift - English allowed!
jobs.description:
Already living in Belgium and looking for a stable logistics job?

Are you a true night owl who performs best during the night? Do you already have some experience in warehouse work or logistics? And are you looking for a stable employer with a lot of job security? Then this could be the perfect job for you!

For a leading logistics company in Oostkamp, we are looking for motivated warehouse workers to join the team in the night shift. You will help distribute frozen food products to supermarkets across Belgium and Europe while working in a modern logistics environment where English is fully accepted.

Your role

As a warehouse operator, you are an important part of the logistics process. Using an electrical pallet truck (EPT), you help ensure that products are received, stored and shipped correctly.

Your responsibilities include:

• Loading and unloading trucks
• Performing quality checks on incoming and outgoing goods
• Keeping the warehouse organised and safe
After a while, you can also receive internal reach truck training and expand your responsibilities.

Be sure to apply if you:

• Have experience in warehouse work or logistics
• Can operate an electrical pallet truck (EPT) with ease
• Aren't afraid of working in cold environments
• Specifically want to work in night shift
• Have your own transportation to the company (no public transport nearby)
Reach truck experience is a big plus but not required.

Warehouse Operator | Flexible Schedule

Are you looking for a side job or a part-time position?

 Can you work from 7:30 AM to 4:00 PM on a weekly basis? Available every other week or every third week? That's possible too!

For our client TVH in Waregem (located near the E17 motorway), we are looking for warehouse employees who would like to work on a flexible schedule.

We are looking for people to sort and unpack incoming parts and goods.

Your responsibilities will include:

 

 
• Sorting delivered goods. 
 
• Physically removing parts and goods from their packaging. 
 
• Checking quantities and stock counts. 
 
• Taking the initiative to keep the workplace clean and tidy. 
 
• Following all safety rules and procedures. 

 
• You can work from 7:30 AM to 4:00 PM. Available every other week or every third week? That's possible too! 
 
• You work accurately and are disciplined in following instructions. 
 
• You have a good command of Dutch or English. 
 
• Physical work is not a problem for you (lifting and carrying items).

Barman — Brusketta
 

Brusketta is a cozy Italian restaurant in Antwerp, known for its warm, authentic atmosphere. We're looking for a 
Barman to join the team, part-time, for evening service.
 

What you'll do
 
 

• Prepare and serve drinks. Cocktails, wine, coffee, aperitivo classics; accurately and efficiently 

• Keep the bar stocked, clean, and ready before service hits 

• Manage the pace of orders during busy periods without losing quality  

• Coordinate with the floor team so drinks and food orders stay in sync 

• Handle guest requests and resolve minor issues with a calm, professional touch  

What you bring
 
 

• Experience as a barman/bartender in hospitality 

• Solid knowledge of classic cocktails and wine  

• Composure under pressure  

• Organized, hands-on, hygiene- and detail-conscious 

• English (required), basic Dutch (required); Italian or French is a real plus  

What's in it for you
 
 

• Part-time, 3–4 evenings per week 

• €15.50–€18.00 brutto/hour, negotiable based on experience 

• Warm, tight-knit team in a well-established neighborhood spot 

• Room to grow within a restaurant group that's expanding  

 Send your CV, a photo, and a short intro to 
hr@lvpgroup.be
